reviews.name: Sachin Jagtap
reviews.text: Got invisible grills for our 9th floor balcony in Charholi. The team came on time for measurement and finished the entire fitting next afternoon. Very neat work, cables are hardly visible from the living room.

reviews.name: Snehal & Rohit Patil
reviews.text: We have a 2 year old daughter so balcony safety was our biggest worry. Local fabricators quoted heavy iron grills which would ruin the society look. Kavach team suggested 2.5mm SS316 wire. Sturdy, clean and looks very modern.

reviews.name: Aniket Kulkarni
reviews.text: Installed both mosquito net and balcony invisible grills together. Mesh sliding is super smooth, no mosquitoes even with windows wide open in the evening. Very reasonable package rate.

reviews.name: Rajesh Nair
reviews.text: Prompt response on WhatsApp. The technicians were polite and cleaned up the drill dust after finishing work. Cables are tensioned tight with zero slack. Highly recommend them for high-rise flats in PCMC.

reviews.name: Vikas Gaikwad
reviews.text: I was skeptical if thin wires can actually hold weight, but the technician demonstrated by pulling with full body force on the tensioned cables. Very solid fitting. Society committee had no objection.

reviews.name: Pooja Mehta
reviews.text: Quick 1-day work for 3 bedroom windows. Good quality powder-coated aluminium frame matching our window colour. Mesh is sturdy and does not bend. Rates are quite fair compared to others in market.

reviews.name: Sandeep More
reviews.text: Pigeon problem was terrible on our dry balcony. After installing Kavach safety wires, birds stopped entering completely and air flow is 100% unaffected. Cleaning balcony is finally peaceful.

reviews.name: Mahesh Shinde
reviews.text: Decent and professional guys. Took proper measurements on Thursday, installed on Saturday morning. Zero vibration or rattling even during heavy monsoon winds. Very happy with the job.
